records.jp: うん、こんなところかな。どうだった？
records.en_original: Well, that's about it I guess. What do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, that's about it I guess. What do you think?
records.en: Well, that's about it I guess. What do you think?

records.jp: ありがとうございます、星崎さん
records.en_original: Thank you very much, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you very much, Ao.
records.en: Thank you very much, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: その……これからも、わからないことがあったら<CR>いろいろ聞いてもいいですか？
records.en_original: Well, um... If there's ever anything I'm unsure about, do you think I could ask you about it?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, um... If there's ever anything I'm unsure about, do you think I could ask you about it?
records.en: Well, um... If there's ever anything I'm unsure about, do you think I could ask you about it?

records.jp: まだわたし、なんにも思い出せなくて……
records.en_original: I still have no memory of anything at all...
records.en_auxiliary: I still have no memory of anything at all...
records.en: I still have no memory of anything at all...

records.jp: もちろん。<CR>私にできることだったらなんでもするよ
records.en_original: Of course. I'll do whatever I can to help.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. I'll do whatever I can to help.
records.en: Of course. I'll do whatever I can to help.

records.jp: ただ……できればこころに聞いてあげてほしいかな
records.en_original: It's just... It'd be nice if you could ask Kokoro.
records.en_auxiliary: It's just... It'd be nice if you could ask Kokoro.
records.en: It's just... It'd be nice if you could ask Kokoro.

records.jp: 靭さんに？
records.en_original: Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro?
records.en: Utsubo-san?

records.jp: 私たちの中で一番詩帆さんのことを知っていて、<CR>手を引っ張ってあげられるのはこころだと思うから
records.en_original: She knows you the best out of all of us, so I think she'd be a lot of help.
records.en_auxiliary: She knows you the best out of all of us, so I think she'd be a lot of help.
records.en: Kokoro knows you best out of all of us, Shiho-san, and I think she's the one who can take your hand and lead you.

records.jp: ……そうなんですね
records.en_original: ...I see.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I see.
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: なにかしなくちゃって思うんです
records.en_original: I feel like there's something I need to do.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like there's something I need to do.
records.en: I feel like there's something I need to do.

records.jp: でも、わたしはいったい、何をすればいいんでしょう
records.en_original: But I have no idea what it could be.
records.en_auxiliary: But I have no idea what it could be.
records.en: But I have no idea what it could be.

records.jp: 記憶を失くして、この世界に来てしまって……。<CR>何をしたら正解なのかわからない
records.en_original: I'm here in this world with no memories... How am I to know what I should do?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm here in this world with no memories... How am I to know what I should do?
records.en: I'm here in this world with no memories... How am I to know what I should do?

records.jp: あはは……生き方すら、<CR>どこかに置いてきちゃったみたいです
records.en_original: Haha... It's as though I've forgotten how to just live.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha... It's as though I've forgotten how to just live.
records.en: Haha... It's as though I've forgotten how to just live.

records.jp: ……そっか
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 私もさ、この世界に来たときはそんな感じだったんだ
records.en_original: That's how I was when I first got here too.
records.en_auxiliary: That's how I was when I first got here too.
records.en: That's how I was when I first got here too.

records.jp: 詩帆さんと違って記憶はあったけど……。<CR>それでも、すごく心細くて……不安だった
records.en_original: I had my memory, but I still felt really...lost. And scared.
records.en_auxiliary: I had my memory, but I still felt really...lost. And scared.
records.en: Unlike you, Shiho-san, I still had my memories... Even so, I felt completely alone and anxious.

records.jp: どうやって……乗り越えたんですか？
records.en_original: Did... Did things change?
records.en_auxiliary: Did... Did things change?
records.en: Did... Did things change?

records.jp: 正直今も不安だよ。でもね……
records.en_original: To be honest, I don't know. I'm still scared. But...
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, I don't know. I'm still scared. But...
records.en: To be honest, I don't know. I'm still scared. But...

records.jp: あの三人となら、やっていけると思ったんだ
records.en_original: Being with those three makes me feel like I can get through it.
records.en_auxiliary: Being with those three makes me feel like I can get through it.
records.en: Being with those three makes me feel like I can get through it.

records.jp: 一緒に探そう？　私たちの、やるべきこと
records.en_original: So let's find that thing you need to do together!
records.en_auxiliary: So let's find that thing you need to do together!
records.en: So let's find that thing you need to do together!

records.jp: 私はさ、他のみんなほど頼りにならないかも<CR>しれないけど……力になるから
records.en_original: I may not be as helpful as the others, but... I'll do anything I can.
records.en_auxiliary: I may not be as helpful as the others, but... I'll do anything I can.
records.en: I may not be as helpful as the others, but... I'll do anything I can.

records.jp: ……そんなことないですよ
records.en_original: ...That's not true.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's not true.
records.en: ...That's not true.

records.jp: 一人じゃないんだって、思えました
records.en_original: You've helped me realize that I am not alone.
records.en_auxiliary: You've helped me realize that I am not alone.
records.en: You've helped me realize that I am not alone.

records.jp: そっか。それならよかった
records.en_original: Oh. Well, I'm glad.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh. Well, I'm glad.
records.en: Oh. Well, I'm glad.

records.jp: じゃあさ、さっそく探してみようよ。<CR>詩帆さんのできること
records.en_original: So let's find something you can do, right now!
records.en_auxiliary: So let's find something you can do, right now!
records.en: Then let's start looking right away for something you can do, Shiho-san.

records.jp: さっきいろいろ回ってみてさ。<CR>何か気になったもの無かった？
records.en_original: You just saw a lot of the stuff we've got here. Does anything come to mind?
records.en_auxiliary: You just saw a lot of the stuff we've got here. Does anything come to mind?
records.en: You just saw a lot of the stuff we've got here. Does anything come to mind?

records.jp: そうですね……うーん……
records.en_original: Let's see... Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's see... Well...
records.en: Let's see... Well...

records.jp: ……料理
records.en_original: ...Cooking.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Cooking.
records.en: ...Cooking.

records.jp: お！
records.en_original: Oooh!
records.en_auxiliary: Oooh!
records.en: Oooh!

records.jp: キッチンを見て思ったんです。<CR>料理なら、わたしにもできるかもしれません
records.en_original: I saw the kitchen. I thought maybe I could be of use as a cook.
records.en_auxiliary: I saw the kitchen. I thought maybe I could be of use as a cook.
records.en: I saw the kitchen. I thought maybe I could be of use as a cook.

records.jp: おおー！　それはめっちゃ助かるかもしれない！
records.en_original: Ooh! That might be super helpful, actually!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh! That might be super helpful, actually!
records.en: Ooh! That might be super helpful, actually!

records.jp: 本当ですか？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: 今までは探索に参加しない勇希がお食事当番で、<CR>たまに他の人も手伝うって感じだったんだけど……
records.en_original: Yuki doesn't explore with us, so she's been doing most of the cooking. We'd help out every now and again, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki doesn't explore with us, so she's been doing most of the cooking. We'd help out every now and again, but...
records.en: Yuki doesn't explore with us, so she's been doing most of the cooking. We'd help out every now and again, but...

records.jp: 詩帆さんが手伝ってくれるならみんな喜ぶよ！
records.en_original: We'd love to have your help!
records.en_auxiliary: We'd love to have your help!
records.en: Everyone will be thrilled if you'll help, Shiho-san!

records.jp: ふふっ。力になれるよう、頑張りますね
records.en_original: Hehe. I'll do my best then!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I'll do my best then!
records.en: Hehe. I'll do my best then!

records.jp: ――あ、そうだ。<CR>ちょっとお願いがあるんですけど、いいですか？
records.en_original: Ah, that's right. Could I ask you a favor?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, that's right. Could I ask you a favor?
records.en: Ah, that's right. Could I ask you a favor?

records.jp: うん、何でも聞いてよ
records.en_original: Sure, what's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, what's up?
records.en: Sure, what's up?

records.jp: わたし、靭さんに何か作ってあげたくて。<CR>材料と道具をお借りしたいんですが……
records.en_original: I'd like to make something for Kokoro. Would it be all right if I used some of the cooking supplies...?
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to make something for Kokoro. Would it be all right if I used some of the cooking supplies...?
records.en: I'd like to make something for Utsubo-san. Would it be all right if I used some of the cooking supplies...?

records.jp: ああ、なるほど！　もちろんいいよ！
records.en_original: Oh, I see! Yeah, no problem!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I see! Yeah, no problem!
records.en: Oh, I see! Yeah, no problem!

records.jp: でも、何を作ればいいか迷っていて……<CR>靭さんの好物とか、ありませんか？
records.en_original: I'm not sure what to make, though... What kind of food does she like?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure what to make, though... What kind of food does she like?
records.en: But I'm not sure what to make... Does Utsubo-san have any favorite foods?

records.jp: そうだなぁ、<CR>こころはなんでも美味しいって言うタイプだからなー
records.en_original: Hmm... Kokoro pretty much likes everything.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Kokoro pretty much likes everything.
records.en: Hmm... Kokoro pretty much likes everything.

records.jp: きっとこころは、詩帆さんが<CR>贈りたいと思ったものなら喜んでくれると思うよ
records.en_original: I'm sure she'd be happy with anything as long as she knew you made it for her.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure she'd be happy with anything as long as she knew you made it for her.
records.en: I'm sure Kokoro will be happy with anything you want to give her, Shiho-san.

records.jp: わたしが、贈りたいと思うもの……
records.en_original: Something I want to make for her…
records.en_auxiliary: Something I want to make for her…
records.en: Something I want to make for her…

records.jp: 私も協力するからさ！　一緒に考えてみよ！
records.en_original: I'll help! We can think of something together!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll help! We can think of something together!
records.en: I'll help! We can think of something together!

records.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: That would be wonderful.
records.en_auxiliary: That would be wonderful.
records.en: That would be wonderful.

records.jp: タレントに、フラグメント装着枠を解放する能力が解放されました
records.en_original: A new ability in your Talents that unlocks Fragment slots has been unlocked.
records.en_auxiliary: A new ability in your Talents that unlocks Fragment slots has been unlocked.
records.en: A new ability in your Talents that unlocks Fragment slots has been unlocked.
